trade_pairs._comment: Bilateral trade relationships pre-loaded from UN Comtrade (reporter's declared exports/imports). WLD = all partners.

licence.note: The free preview API may not allow commercial use; UN Comtrade sells a commercial tier.

fundamentals._comment: USDA PSD supply-and-demand balance sheets by country and market year (bulk CSV, no key). price_model_basis follows USDA's convention of excluding China's largely state-held grain, oilseed and cotton stocks.

licence.note: U.S. government data.

policy_rates._comment: Daily central bank policy rates from the BIS, one per currency area. Germany, France and Italy share the euro area's rate.

licence.note: The BIS must be cited as the source, and including its statistics in a commercial product must not add to what users are charged. Confirm the current terms with the BIS before selling access.
